name: late promise rejection handler event
source: async function main(): Promise<void> { const events: string[] = []; process.on('unhandledRejection', () => events.push('unhandled')); process.on('rejectionHandled', () => events.push('handled')); const pending = Promise.reject(new Error('late')); await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1)); pending.catch(() => {}); await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve)); console.log(events.join(',')); }
